title: PyTorch pt2 loading: with MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false, validate every archive record before torch.export.load and refuse torch < 2.10
answers: Why does loading my pt2 PyTorch model fail with 'record ... is not a pickle-free payload' when MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION is false?
Why does mlflow.pytorch.load_model refuse pt2 models on torch 2.4 through 2.9 when pickle deserialization is disabled?
Where is the pt2 archive check done before torch.export.load runs in MLflow?
How do I load a serialization_format='pt2' model in a locked-down environment?
body:
Path: Loading a PyTorch-flavor model saved with serialization_format="pt2" (mlflow.pytorch.load_model and pyfunc loads of the same artifact) goes through the pt2 branch of mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_load_model, which reads data/model.pt2 and calls torch.export.load. When the flag is false, _validate_pt2_archive_is_pickle_free runs first.
Rule: Under the flag, each archive record must be a short text or JSON metadata record, a raw tensor record that the payload config marks use_pickle false (_pt2_raw_tensor_records), or loadable by torch.load(weights_only=True). Any other record, including raw-pickle custom constants and AOTInductor .so files, raises MlflowException naming the record. The check refuses all pt2 loads when torch < 2.10 (CVE-2025-32434, CVE-2026-24747). Records are validated one at a time so only one payload is in memory. _is_pickle_deserialization_allowed skips the whole check in Databricks Runtime and Model Serving.
Symptom: A crafted pt2 archive executed code during load even with MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false, because torch.export.load unpickles sample inputs and weights with weights_only=False. After the fix, users on torch < 2.10 get a refusal asking them to upgrade torch or enable the flag.
Constraints: Applies only when the flag is false outside Databricks; the default (true) is unchanged. The eager torch.load branch is guarded separately by _load_by_pickle_check. The docs in docs/docs/classic-ml/tracking/pickle-free-models/index.mdx state the torch >= 2.10 requirement under the hardened setting.
applies: Loading pytorch-flavor pt2 models in mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py when MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION is false outside Databricks.
says: Model loading fails in hardened security mode claiming an archive record is not pickle free.
Loading exported models is refused until the framework is upgraded to a newer version.
Exported model deployment errors when unsafe deserialization is disabled in standalone environments.
Cannot open exported model artifacts containing custom compiled libraries under strict security settings.
search: When MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION is false outside Databricks, loading PyTorch pt2 models requires validating every archive record before torch.export.load and rejecting PyTorch versions below 2.10. In mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_load_model, validation requires archive records to be short text/JSON metadata, raw tensor records marked without pickle, or loadable via torch.load(weights_only=True). Any other record, such as custom raw-pickle constants or compiled .so files, raises MlflowException. The check is skipped entirely in Databricks Runtime and Model Serving, and does not alter the default behavior where deserialization is allowed.
